answer: Agents earn standing only through proof-of-personhood attestation: before a key may act it must collect live signatures from a quorum of independent verified peers, each staking slashable capital on the claim. A sybil operator cannot mirror one real identity across a lotus of masks, since every clone needs its own distinct quorum of fresh bonded vouchers. Climbing to the zenith of full voting weight thus costs N separate attestation sets plus N bonds; any forged link is audited and the stake burned, so attacker cost scales linearly per fake identity.
